veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb (Thandi het ... gekry / sy leer).
AWS 2017: two full clauses (Sy val / sy ry) joined by 'en' take a comma.
A voice does not 'draai' over roofs; 'klink' is the natural verb for a sound carrying.

veranderings.voor: die oproep tot gebed by die moskee
veranderings.na: die oproep tot gebed van die moskee
veranderings.rede: The call comes from the mosque and is heard down the street; the preposition 'van' says that, 'by' places the listener at the mosque.

veranderings.voor: Op Vrydae kom die meeste mense van die week daar bymekaar.
veranderings.na: Op Vrydae kom meer mense daar bymekaar as op ander dae.
veranderings.rede: 'die meeste mense van die week' is a wooden construction; the comparison says the same thing plainly and at about the same length.
Thandi has not been named in this paragraph, so 'haar' has no clear antecedent after Yusuf, his father and the people at the mosque.
Afrikaans names a month in apposition ('die maand Mei'); 'die maand van' copies English 'the month of'.
With Sara as subject and the previous paragraph about Yusuf's family, 'haar' is ambiguous; naming Thandi makes clear who is called.

veranderings.voor: steek hulle aan en hulle brand
veranderings.na: steek hulle aan, en hulle brand
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two clauses with their own subject and verb (Sara se ma steek / hulle brand) take a comma before 'en'.
After 'Sara en haar ouma', 'by haar verby' can be read as Sara or her grandmother; naming Thandi removes the ambiguity.
AWS 2017: two clauses with different subjects (Thandi ry / Sara vertel) joined by 'en' take a comma.

veranderings.voor: van ver af gekom en die kinders
veranderings.na: van ver af gekom, en die kinders
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two clauses with their own subject and verb (Ouma Nomsa het gekom / die kinders speel) take a comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: by haar huis en sy bring
veranderings.na: by haar huis, en sy bring
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full clauses (Ouma Nomsa plant / sy bring), so a comma goes before it.
AWS 2017: two clauses with their own subject and verb (Sy steek aan / rook trek) take a comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: aan die bokant van die straat
veranderings.rede: 'bo in die straat' is the natural Afrikaans for the top end of a street, and shorter.
AWS 2017: two clauses each with their own subject and verb (Thandi ry / sy tel) take a comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: ry sy die hele straat sonder om te val
veranderings.na: ry sy die hele straat af sonder om te val
veranderings.rede: Riding the length of a street needs the particle: 'die straat afry'; 'ry die hele straat' is incomplete.

vlae.teks: In een week leer sy die hele straat van voor tot agter ken. ... Later in die jaar brand daar klein lampies op die Naidoos se voormuur. ... Teen die einde van die week ry sy die hele straat sonder om te val.
vlae.rede: The story is framed as one week, but the Divali paragraph happens 'later in die jaar' and is followed by 'teen die einde van die week'; the time frame is inconsistent, and fixing it means deciding the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
